raw_translation: Wannan mai gyara hotuna biyu na gwaji na iya yin kuskure a kan abubuwan da ke motsa, da na'urori masu rarrabawa, da na'urori masu karkatarwa ko kuma na'urori masu rarrabuwa. Ka binciki haɗe-haɗe da daidaitawa kafin ka yi amfani da shi; shi ba aikin gyara hotuna ko kuma aikin RAW na ƙwarewa ba ne.
source: This experimental two-photo stitcher can fail on low-texture scenes, moving objects, distortion or weak overlap. Review seams and alignment before use; it is not a professional photo-editing or RAW workflow.
translation: Wannan mai gyara hotuna biyu na gwaji na iya yin kuskure a kan abubuwan da ke motsa, da na'urori masu rarrabawa, da na'urori masu karkatarwa ko kuma na'urori masu rarrabuwa. Ka binciki haɗe-haɗe da daidaitawa kafin ka yi amfani da shi; shi ba aikin gyara hotuna ko kuma aikin RAW na ƙwarewa ba ne.
